name: unified_calibrate
description: Unified per-component Tessera calibration. Runs per_tensor_calibrate.py on each --component and combines the per-component policies into a single llama.speculative.calibration-policy.v1 JSON keyed by model_role. The driver that walks (trunk, dflash, dspark, mtp_nextn, shared_embd) and stitches the per-role policy together.

component.description: A component to calibrate as ROLE=PATH (e.g. trunk=path/to/layers, dflash=path/to/bundle). May be specified multiple times; order is preserved in the unified policy.

fitness.description: Forwarded to per_tensor_calibrate.py when --fitness-default is not 'auto'. Ignored when --fitness-default is 'auto'.

fitness_default.description: How to pick the per-component --fitness. 'auto' consults ROLE_DEFAULT_FITNESS: trunk->awq, dflash/dspark/mtp_nextn->lrq, shared_embd->flrq.

per_tensor_calibrate.description: Path to per_tensor_calibrate.py. Defaults to the sibling script in the same directory as this one.

output.description: Unified calibration policy JSON output path.

keep_intermediate.description: Keep the per-component intermediate policy files in a subdirectory next to --output (useful for debugging which component's calibration contributed which tensor).

extra_arg.description: Extra CLI arg forwarded to per_tensor_calibrate.py on every component. May be specified multiple times.

db.description: Optional path to the unified tessera.duckdb. When provided, the embedding-budget producer reads tensor_stats and emits a role_budgets sidecar.

budget_fraction.description: Base fraction for the role size envelope: E(r) = source_footprint_bits(r) * fraction. Non-positive opts out of the size envelope.

no_embedding_budget.description: Opt out of the M2 embedding-budget integration. The sidecar is emitted without role_budgets, preserving the pre-M2 contract.
